Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc. / MA (VRTX) reported revenue of $2.8 billion for Q1 FY2025, the quarter ended 31 March 2025, up 3.0% on the same quarter a year earlier. Net income was $646 million, down 41.2% on the year, and diluted earnings per share $2.49.

Revenue**$2.8 billion***up 3.0%*
Net income**$646 million***down 41.2%*
Diluted EPS**$2.49**
